"""One extra real pure-L1 process/serialization seam, using the shared runner."""
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import pandas as pd
from scripts.market_state.common import ROOT
from scripts.market_state.framework import DataStore
from scripts.market_state.interface_acceptance import assert_interface_accepted
from scripts.market_state.experiments.config import load_config
from scripts.market_state.experiments.runtime import environment, experiment_code_hash
from scripts.market_state.experiments.artifacts import read_json, atomic_json, native_path
from scripts.market_state.experiments.technical import _batch


def main():
    store, config = DataStore(), load_config()
    assert_interface_accepted(data_root=store.root)
    tests=read_json(ROOT/'reports/market_state/model_io/test_results.json')
    assert tests['exit_code']==0 and tests['experiment_code_hash']==experiment_code_hash()
    parameters=dict(alpha=5.945570708544395e-5,l1_ratio=1.,tol=1e-4,max_iter=10000)
    design=[dict(market='000985.SH',fold='2020-01',task='regression',information=i,parameters=parameters) for i in ['M','M+Z']]
    result=dict(purpose='SMOKE_ONLY',formal_BC_started=False,code=experiment_code_hash(),environment=environment(),
        design=design,harness_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mlec-l1-process-',dir=native_path(tempfile.gettempdir())) as temp:
        root=Path(temp)
        serial,a,al=_batch(config,store,root/'serial',1,design)
        parallel,b,bl=_batch(config,store,root/'parallel',2,design)
        for left,right,ls,rs in zip(a,b,al,bl):
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(left,right,check_exact=True)
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(ls,rs,check_exact=True)
        result.update(status='PASSED',serial=serial,parallel=parallel,predictions_exact=True,scores_exact=True,
            predictions_retained=False,model_weights_retained=False)
    atomic_json(ROOT/'reports/model_build/elastic_net/optimization_20261119/pure_l1_serial_parallel.json',result)
    print('PURE_L1_SERIAL_PARALLEL_PASSED; save/load and resume verified; no formal B/C')


if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    if sys.argv[1:] != ['--execute']:
        raise SystemExit('Explicit --execute required for this real technical check')
    main()
